title: Belrose Circle Membership Programme Terms, Clause 2: One Membership per Customer
content:
# Belrose Circle Membership Programme Terms — Clause 2: One Membership per Customer

**2.1** A customer holds one Belrose Circle Membership Programme membership and no more, because the programme is built on one identity and one earning record.

**2.2** A membership is opened for a customer only when no membership already recorded against the same membership number stands at enrolled, active, review pending, lapsed or suspended.

**2.3** Where a customer has closed a membership and wishes to rejoin, a fresh membership is opened at the entry tier, and the points from the closed membership are not carried across.

**2.4** The number of memberships of any one tier that a customer may hold is fixed per tier, as is the smallest age in whole years at which each tier may be held; the programme-wide limit under clause 2.1 is 1 membership per customer.

## Basis of the decision under clause 2.2

The question whether a membership may be opened is answered from the membership records held by the company, before the membership is opened, and not from the customer's own account of what they hold. The records are read for the membership number, the status of each membership found against it and the customer it belongs to. Two memberships against one membership number are told apart by their enrolment date and by the tier recorded on each.

| Status of a membership already recorded against the same membership number | Outcome under clause 2.2 |
|---|---|
| enrolled | no membership is opened |
| active | no membership is opened |
| review pending | no membership is opened |
| lapsed | no membership is opened |
| suspended | no membership is opened |
| closed | a fresh membership is opened at the entry tier under clause 2.3, without the closed membership's points |
| no membership recorded against the number | a membership is opened |

A lapsed membership is a live membership for the purpose of clause 2.2: it counts against the customer as fully as an active one.

## What a newly opened membership records

A membership opened under this clause is recorded at the status enrolled, with the tier it is joined at, the date it is joined, the membership number the customer quotes at the till, the referral code the customer will give the people they refer, the store the member's benefits default to, and the month the member's anniversary benefits fall in. The membership moves from enrolled to active when it begins earning. A customer who withdraws before the membership has begun earning moves it from enrolled to closed.

## Cases under the clause (hypothetical)

- A customer whose only membership recorded against their number stands at lapsed asks to join afresh: no membership is opened, because a lapsed membership stands under clause 2.2.
- A customer whose only membership recorded against their number stands at closed asks to join afresh: a fresh membership is opened at the entry tier; the points on the closed membership are not carried across.
- A customer with no membership recorded against the number quoted: a membership is opened, at the status enrolled.
